sections.heading: Overview

sections.content: Secure experienced, high-quality food operators capable of delivering innovative food and beverage concepts that are reliable, affordable, moveable and appealing to diverse visitors while enhancing the experience and respecting the environmental and cultural value of the sites at Royal Botanic Garden of Sydney.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content: Refer to the RFP Documents attached for full details.
sections.heading: Scope

sections.content:
Respondents are recommended to attend a site inspection. This visit will ensure a clear understanding of the site conditions and requirements.
A maximum of 4 attendees per respondent can attend.
To confirm your attendance you must provide the following info at least 2 working days before the date of the site inspection:
Preferred site inspection session time
Name of the persons attending
Email the details to Mario Da Silva commercial.services@botanicgardens.nsw.gov.au.
Site Inspection Dates and times:
The Point (Mrs Macquaries Point), Mrs Macquaries Road, Sydney NSW at:
10am, Thursday 10 September 2026
10am, Thursday 17 September 2026
The Cove (Gate K – Yurong Gate, foreshore side near Victoria Lodge),Royal Botanic Garden Sydney, NSW at:
10.45am, Thursday 10 September 2026
10.45am, Thursday 17 September 2026
QEII Gate (Gate J – Queen Elizabeth II Gate), Royal Botanic Garden Sydney,NSW at:
11.30am, Thursday 10 September 2026
11.30am, Thursday 17 September 2026
